description: Convert a flat, unstructured legacy PDF invoice (max 5 pages) into a compliant ZUGFeRD 2.5 PDF/A-3b using guarded AI extraction verified by deterministic BigDecimal math and ISO 13616 MOD-97 IBAN checks. Use ONLY when you have a flat PDF and no structured JSON; prefer embed_zugferd_pdf when structured JSON is available, or generate_erechnung when creating an invoice from scratch. Returns JSON with format ('ZUGFERD'), profile, filename, mimeType ('application/pdf'), sizeBytes, and pdfBase64 (or an actionable validation error if math/IBAN guardrails fail).

pdfBase64.description: Base64-encoded flat legacy PDF invoice (1 to 5 pages) to extract and convert into ZUGFeRD 2.5 PDF/A-3b.

profile.description: Compliance profile: 'EN16931' for standard German B2B invoices (DATEV ZUGFeRD 2.5 Comfort), or 'XRECHNUNG' for strict KoSIT XRechnung 3.0.2 public-sector rules (requires buyerReference, seller email/phone, buyer email).

stampGiroCode.description: When true, stamps a scannable EPC SEPA GiroCode QR code onto the visual ZUGFeRD PDF using seller.bankDetails[0].iban.

name: magic_convert_pdf
